name: WF-184 — Closing Authorization Confirmation → Closing Execution & Milestone Activation

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json??{}; const auth=input.closing_authorization??input.authorization??{}; const execution=input.execution??input.closingExecution??{}; const packageValidation=input.closing_package_validation??{}; const milestones=Array.isArray(input.milestones)?input.milestones:[]; const launchKey=String(execution.launchIdempotencyKey??input.launchIdempotencyKey??'').trim(); const executionId=String(execution.id??execution.executionId??'').trim(); const authorized=auth.status==='confirmed'||auth.status==='already_confirmed'; const packageReady=packageValidation.status==='package_ready'||input.packageReady===true; const alreadyActive=execution.status==='active'||execution.active===true; const blockers=Array.isArray(input.blockers)?input.blockers.filter(Boolean):[]; const gaps=[]; if(!authorized)gaps.push('closing_authorization_confirmation'); if(!packageReady)gaps.push('final_package_ready'); if(!launchKey)gaps.push('launch_idempotency_key'); if(!executionId&&!alreadyActive)gaps.push('execution_identity'); if(blockers.length)gaps.push('blockers_cleared'); const activationId=String(input.activationId??execution.activationId??('close:'+launchKey)).trim(); let status=blockers.length?'blocked':alreadyActive?'already_active':gaps.length?'activation_required':'activated'; const activeState={status:status==='activated'||status==='already_active'?'active':status,execution_id:executionId||null,activation_id:activationId||null,launch_idempotency_key:launchKey||null,started_at:status==='activated'?(input.now??new Date().toISOString()):null,milestones:milestones.map((m,i)=>({...m,sequence:m.sequence??i+1,status:m.status??'pending'}))}; const route=status==='activated'||status==='already_active'?'WF-185':status==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-183'; return [{json:{...input,workflow:'WF-184',execution_activation:{status,missing_requirements:gaps,active_state:activeState},routing:{next_workflow:route,reason:status,requires_human_review:status==='blocked'||status==='activation_required'},audit:{event:'closing_execution_milestone_activation_evaluated',status,activation_id:activationId||null}}}];
